The kingdom of Gilneas [ 1 ] (pronounced "Gil-NEIGH-uhs"), or the Gilnean kingdom , [ 2 ] is one of the seven human kingdoms and is located in the peninsula of Gilneas , situated southwest of Silverpine Forest on the continent of Lordaeron . It is ruled by King Genn Greymane of the Greymane family . After the events of the Cataclysm , Gilneas rejoined the Alliance , and they have been trying to reclaim their homeland ever since. The nation's colors are described as a red design consisting of a circle with three vertical lines, akin to lances, and another line bisecting the circle itself, all set within a field of gray. [ 3 ]

Baron Silverlaine.
Baron Silverlaine is a human ghost and the second boss in Shadowfang Keep . He is located in the Dining Hall, or Great Hall via teleport.
Baron Silveraline and his family were killed by the worgen , summoned by Archmage Arugal from the Emerald Dream to aid Gilneans against the Scourge , after they turned on the Gilneans. After the Fourth War , Mathias Shaw reported a common belief that the ghost of Baron Silverlaine still haunts the keep. [ 1 ]

Gilneas Alliance [  ]

The people of Gilneas are a nation of survivors. Having walled themselves off from the rest of humanity, they must now face new threats from within.
After the fall of the Greymane Wall, which had kept the nation of Gilneas isolated from the rest of Azeroth, most of the surviving population established themselves elsewhere in Azeroth thanks to an offer of allegiance and aid from the night elves of the Alliance. The worgen curse still plagues Gilnean refugees, but, even as they wear the forms of beasts, their shared history and pride have prevented the total collapse of their besieged nation. Gilneans now dwell in Darnassus, Felwood, and Duskwood, among other locales, and their king, Genn Greymane, stands at the side of the leader of Stormwind, Varian Wrynn.
Those who earn the faith and confidence of the proud Gilneans can avail themselves of some of the finery their nation is known for: capes, tabards, bags, and more.

web.title: Boralus Harbor
web.description: **Boralus Harbor** is one of the core districts of [Boralus](/wiki/Boralus), the capital city of [Kul Tiras](/wiki/Kul_Tiras_(kingdom)). Aside from [Proudmoore Keep](/wiki/Proudmoore_Keep), it is the most heavily guarded part of the city and the only place most visitors ever get to see.[1] Its main area is the [Tradewinds Market](/wiki/Tradewinds_Market). [Dockwarden Finnson](/wiki/Dockwarden_Finnson) oversees all registry duties for guilds and trading companies in the harbor.

web.title: Greymane family
web.description:
The **Greymane** family (also known as the **Greymane clan**)[1] is the ruling line of the [kingdom of Gilneas](/wiki/Gilneas_(kingdom)). The family ruled from [Greymane Manor](/wiki/Greymane_Manor)

- [King Genn Greymane](/wiki/Genn_Greymane) (and [Queen Mia Greymane](/wiki/Mia_Greymane)) - Ruler of the human and worgen of Gilneas, affected by the [worgen](/wiki/Worgen) curse himself. Mia is the wife of Genn and mother of Tess and Liam.[2]
- [Prince Liam Greymane](/wiki/Liam_Greymane) - son of Genn Greymane. Died during the [Battle for Gilneas City](/wiki/The_Battle_for_Gilneas_City).
- [Princess Tess Greymane](/wiki/Tess_Greymane), daughter of Genn Greymane.[3]

**Queen Tess Greymane** is a member of the [Royal Family](/wiki/Greymane_family) of [Gilneas](/wiki/Gilneas_(kingdom)), the daughter of King [Genn Greymane](/wiki/Genn_Greymane).[2] Following to her [brother](/wiki/Liam_Greymane)'s death, Tess became heir to the throne of the kingdom of Gilneas.[3]

After the city was reclaimed from the Scarlet Crusade, Genn Greymane abdicated the throne and gave the leadership of Gilneas to Tess.

- Tess appears as [a legendary card](https://hearthstone.fandom.com/wiki/Tess_Greymane) for the rogue class in the *[The Witchwood](/wiki/Hearthstone:_The_Witchwood)* expansion for *[Hearthstone](/wiki/Hearthstone_(game))*. web.title: What You May Regret
web.description:
<Name>, [Genn Greymane](/wiki/Genn_Greymane) left this letter for you. He indicated it was urgent. I was just about to send for you.
<Upon opening it, the letter reads as follows.>
"<Name>,
You have helped to unite the Kul Tirans and gained their support for the [Alliance](/wiki/Alliance). Perhaps now you might be able to help reunite a [mother](/wiki/Katherine_Proudmoore) with her [daughter](/wiki/Jaina_Proudmoore).
Meet me at the family memorial by [Proudmoore Keep](/wiki/Proudmoore_Keep). With luck we can convince Lord Admiral Proudmoore to grant her daughter a stay of execution.
- Genn Greymane "

web.title: The Old Knight
web.description:
I lost my mother when the [Scourge](/wiki/Scourge) hit [Lordaeron](/wiki/Lordaeron). My father sent me here to be raised away from the war. I don't know much about him... just that he was a [Stormwind](/wiki/Stormwind_(kingdom)) knight who gave his life fighting the [Lich King](/wiki/Lich_King).

- *Just on the other side of Cyrus's office, Harbor Guards are preventing passengers of the Alliance ship, including [Genn Greymane](/wiki/Genn_Greymane), from disembarking. Cyrus is less than pleased.*

These days Cyrus is the Harbormaster, but he used to be one of Daelin Proudmoore's most trusted knights! Until I came along. You see, my mother was from Lordaeron and my father was a Stormwind knight. When he lost my mother to the Scourge, my father sent me here. Then he... well, all I've been told is that he gave his life to defeat the Lich King. Daelin hand-picked Cyrus to raise me. He would have never taken a desk job otherwise.

web.title: Tandred Proudmoore
web.description: Tandred Proudmoore is a captain of the Kul Tiran fleet, son of the former Lord Admiral Daelin and Katherine Proudmoore, and the youngest brother of Derek and Jaina. He is described as a fearless explorer and sailor of uncharted waters.[1] ... ## In the RPG This section contains information from the Warcraft RPG which is considered non-canon. Admiral Tandred Proudmoore was left to hold Kul Tiras together while both, Jaina Proudmoore and Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore sailed west.[8] He took the position of ruler of the Kul Tiras following his father's demise in Theramore. Tandred is a good person but doesn't have his father's courage as he is not the man his father was. He gets a lot of help from his lady friend, Captain Mishan Waycrest. Tandred does the best he can with the few men and fewer allies he has left. He is classified as a fighter and aristocrat.[9] ... Gilnean military Gilneas Liberation Front - Refugee Leadership

web.title: House of Nobles
web.description: The House of Nobles is a political assembly that forms part of the government of the Kingdom of Stormwind, comprised of some of Stormwind's most powerful aristocratic bloodlines. Positions within the organization are typically inherited.[1] Under the direction of the kingdom's ruling dynasty, the House of Wrynn, the monarch of Stormwind is aided in their role as head of government by the House of Nobles, which possesses considerable power on many internal matters and the running of the kingdom's day to day affairs. ... Among the corrupt nobles, Edwin VanCleef had an ally, Lord Gregor Lescovar, an aristocrat who conspired with the Defias against King Varian Wrynn.[26] He was later assassinated by Tyrion and an adventurer on the orders of Elling Trias.[27] ... web.title: Barbarian
web.description: 2,700 years ago before the First War, the Drust barbarians of Drustvar enacted raids against the humans from Gilneas who arrived on Kul Tiras.[13] Though the humans tried peace when they landed there, the Drust immediately went to war. They attacked the fledgling hamlets unprovoked, while their barbarians glorified the slaughters, attacking unarmed civilians.[14] These raids lasted several years until an open war broke out between the two races for control of the region.

After becoming worgen, it would make sense for them to gain an even greater aptitude for the wilds.
